facts.en: Completed a recreation-service certificate at Fictional Frostfern College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构霜蕨学院完成康乐服务证书课程。

facts.en: Paid skate-hire assistant at Fictional Amberice Rink from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在虚构琥珀冰滑冰场任有薪冰鞋租赁助理。

facts.en: Issued skate sizes requested by visitors and recorded the rental reference on the return rack label.
facts.zh: 发放访客请求尺码的冰鞋，并在归还架标签上记录租赁编号。

facts.en: Referred fit concerns or visible equipment damage to the rink supervisor before issuing a replacement.
facts.zh: 在发放替换品前，将合脚问题或可见设备损坏转交滑冰场主管。

facts.en: Counted returned pairs and kept incomplete pairs separate from available rental stock.
facts.zh: 清点归还的成对冰鞋，并将不成对冰鞋与可租库存分开。

facts.en: Updated the desk count sheet when pairs were placed on the supervisor’s maintenance hold list.
facts.zh: 当成对冰鞋被列入主管维护暂留清单时，更新柜台计数表。

facts.en: A 2025-12 end-of-shift record shows 86 pairs returned, including 4 pairs on maintenance hold; the 4 are part of the 86, not additional returns.
facts.zh: 一份 2025-12 班末记录显示归还 86 双冰鞋，其中 4 双暂留维护；这 4 双包含在 86 双内，并非额外归还。

facts.en: Processed rental payments using the desk till and handed refund requests to the senior receptionist.
facts.zh: 使用柜台收银系统处理租赁付款，并将退款请求交给高级接待员。

facts.en: Explained the posted rental return time and directed lesson questions to the skating-school desk.
facts.zh: 说明公示的租赁归还时间，并将课程问题转交滑冰学校柜台。

facts.en: Helped trial a larger size-label format on 3 rental racks in 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-03 协助在 3 个租赁架上试用版面更大的尺码标签。

facts.en: Personally checked label readability at the service counter; the supervisor chose the final rack arrangement.
facts.zh: 个人在服务柜台检查标签可读性；最终货架安排由主管选择。

facts.en: Uses a rental till, size-indexed racks and spreadsheet stock exports.
facts.zh: 使用租赁收银系统、按尺码索引的货架及电子表格库存导出文件。

facts.en: Observed a staff blade-sharpening demonstration in 2025-09; the record contains no supervised practice or independent sharpening assignment.
facts.zh: 2025-09 观摩员工冰刀磨刃演示；记录不含受监督练习或独立磨刃任务。

facts.en: As of 2026-09, the candidate reports availability for Saturday and Sunday afternoon shifts.
facts.zh: 截至 2026-09，候选人表示可在星期六及星期日下午班工作。

facts.en: Plays recreational ice hockey with Fictional Pinepuck Social Team and attends a weekly noncompetitive practice.
facts.zh: 在虚构松果球社交队休闲打冰球，并参加每周非竞技练习。

facts.en: For that team, voluntarily maintained a jersey-loan list during the 2025 practice season.
facts.zh: 在 2025 年练习季为该队志愿维护球衣借用清单。

facts.en: A team coach led skating drills; the candidate has no recorded coaching appointment.
facts.zh: 滑行训练由球队教练带领；未记录候选人的教练任命。

facts.en: Made a personal tabletop rink model from card in 2024, including removable paper team markers.
facts.zh: 2024 年用卡纸制作个人桌面冰场模型，包含可移除纸质队伍标记。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing invented team logos.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制虚构队徽。

facts.en: Prepared handovers listing unreturned rentals, incomplete pairs and equipment held for supervisor review.
facts.zh: 准备交接，列明未归还租赁冰鞋、不成对冰鞋及留待主管审核的设备。
